verdict.rationale: The evidence shows developers can build their own pieces in TypeScript and that a catalog of 760+ apps exists. Nothing documents that pieces are contributed by the community outside the vendor, or that a developer can install such third-party pieces. Building your own piece is a developer building block, not the capability to install community-built integrations, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install community-built nodes, components, or integrations contributed outside the vendor
